summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the redemption of its 500,000,000 1.985% Fixed Rate Reset Subordinated Debt Securities due 2031 (ISIN XS2351166421). The entire outstanding principal will be redeemed on September 15, 2026 at 100% of par plus accrued interest. The listing on the NYSE will be cancelled. This is a routine debt redemption by the issuer, not a corporate event qualifying as a special situation. No equity, merger, or strategic action is involved, so it is classified as None.
